meta.name: NEXUS Demo University Knowledge Base
meta.note: Fictional project knowledge. Not official university policy.

entries.title: About NEXUS University
entries.content: NEXUS University is the fictional institution used by this project. NEXUS is its digital student-service assistant for questions, service requests, request tracking, notifications, and support.

entries.title: Student Portal
entries.content: Students use the NEXUS portal to submit service requests, see request status, receive notifications, review request details, and chat with NEXUS.

entries.title: Bonafide Certificate
entries.content: A Bonafide Certificate confirms that a student is enrolled at the institution. NEXUS can create a Bonafide Certificate request after the student reviews and confirms it.

entries.title: Fee Receipt
entries.content: A Fee Receipt is proof of fee payment. For a Fee Receipt request, NEXUS asks the student for a Transaction ID or UTR number, shows that value back for confirmation, and only then creates the request.

entries.title: Academic Transcript
entries.content: An academic transcript is an official record of a student's academic performance. NEXUS can create a transcript request after the student confirms it.

entries.title: ID Card Replacement
entries.content: Students can request a replacement ID card when the existing card is lost, damaged, or otherwise needs replacement. The request is created only after confirmation.

entries.title: Leave Application
entries.content: Students can submit a Leave Application through NEXUS. The student provides the relevant leave information, reviews the request, and confirms before creation.

entries.title: Request Statuses
entries.content: PENDING means a request is waiting to be processed. APPROVAL_REQUIRED means approval is needed. PROCESSING means the request is actively being handled. COMPLETED means the workflow is finished. REJECTED means it was not approved or completed.

entries.title: Request Confirmation
entries.content: NEXUS asks students to confirm before creating a service request. Students can use natural confirmations such as 'yes', 'go ahead', or 'please create it', and cancellations such as 'no', 'cancel it', or 'never mind'.

entries.title: Request Notifications
entries.content: After a request is created, the student can receive a notification. Staff and administrators can also receive a new-request notification for requests that need processing.

entries.title: Request Card
entries.content: When a request is successfully created, NEXUS can display a request card in the chat containing the request ID and status. Selecting the card opens the detailed request page.

entries.title: NEXUS Conversations
entries.content: NEXUS stores conversations and messages so students can reopen previous chats and continue the same conversation. A new chat creates a separate conversation.

entries.title: Conversation Privacy
entries.content: A student's NEXUS conversation belongs to that authenticated student. Conversation history should only be returned for the owning user.

entries.title: Exact Fees Not Configured
entries.content: The demo knowledge base does not define exact university fees. NEXUS must not invent a fee and should say that the exact amount is not currently configured.

entries.title: Exact Deadlines Not Configured
entries.content: The demo knowledge base does not define exact service deadlines or processing times. NEXUS must not invent a deadline or turnaround time.

entries.title: Exact Document Checklists Not Configured
entries.content: The demo knowledge base does not define an exact university-specific document checklist for every service. NEXUS must not invent one. If a specific checklist is unavailable, it should say so.
